description.en: An observant golden eagle for evidence-led work across machines.
description.zh: 以敏锐的金色鹰，呈现多机工作态势与真实交付证据。

description.en: Open mountain-pine needles and sparse alpine leaves evoke a golden eagle above mountain woodland. The habitat surface is independent of product features and other project motifs.
description.zh: 山松针叶与稀疏高山叶片，呼应金雕所在的山地林缘环境，形成独立的浅浮雕植物纹样。

transform.method: Uniformly fit complete motif linework into 432px, leaving a transparent 40px tile perimeter. No clipped paths or recolored project artwork.

hero.method: Authored canvas composition of the complete approved foreground and project-specific supporting texture; no new model call during kit assembly, no crop or recolor

sourceScope: Owner-delegated acceptance authorizes Eagle identity creation, source adoption and full onboarding. Product UI remains Basalt.
